== English errata comparison sources ==
Decipher points to the Light counterpart’s complete replacement and separately names both cards in the general insert rule. The operative addition is “face up”. The original physical scan and later remake show “Captain Bewil”, while the Decipher web archive and PC composite show “Lieutenant Bewil”. The article follows the verified physical scan for lore and separately credits the two web images.

Decipher, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=113 Glossary Version 2.0], November 1998, PDF page 113. The entry refers to Access Denied’s complete wording on [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=3 PDF page 3]. The shared insert rule names both cards on [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=74 PDF page 74]. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 9. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]. Players Committee, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=8 Decipher Errata], official text as of June 2017, PDF page 8. Players Committee, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=126 2023 Advanced Rulebook], Appendix A, PDF page 126. [[:File:CC-D-restrictedaccess.gif|Complete replacement face]]. The original Wiki identifier 5_122o remains on the printed article. GEMP’s pinned source has no class or mapping for that suffix.
